parsed.rationale: Regular rhythm at about 75-80 bpm with narrow QRS complexes, normal R-wave progression, and no voltage criteria for LVH. The mild concave ST elevation with tall T waves in V2-V4 looks like a normal variant (early repolarization) and has no reciprocal changes, so it does not meet STEMI criteria.
